integrity: The negative-energy surface argument, global uniqueness, and Floquet contraction are proved analytically. A finite symbolic checker supports algebra but is not an infinite proof. A published existence computation is credited, not independently reproduced. No independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness and conditional attraction hold for \(q\ge2\); existence is supplied by previously published results (\(q=2,3\) analytically and through \(q=100\) computationally). All forward trajectories are not shown bounded. The full text of an especially relevant 2024 paper was inaccessible, leaving priority uncertainty.
title: Uniqueness and leafwise attraction of the generalized Chazy periodic cylinder
